items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Fix narrows findTsxServerPids() to the deploying repo/worktree exactly as requested; no extra features.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: findTsxServerPids fails closed on missing repoRoot ([]); JSON.parse wrapped in try/catch; existing OS-call try/catch preserved.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No user input reaches these code paths; spawnSync shell:false unchanged; no secrets touched.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: New tests assert on outcomes (which PIDs survive filtering) with realistic fixtures; each helper has positive + negative cases.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: No loops/DB/pagination concerns; process-list filtering only.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: kill-targets.js stays under 300 lines; new test file created to keep kill-targets.test.js under the 300-line guideline.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: No serialized/user-edited file format changed; this is OS process command-line matching, not a producer/consumer file format.
